provenance.evidence_metric: complete annotated utterance text and original source span
provenance.indexing: one dialogue utterance per canonical user-role turn; speaker prefix; text only
provenance.date_time_convention: source local clock represented as UTC for deterministic ordering

provenance.frozen_before: first candidate evaluation on these cases
provenance.cohort: 36 queries, 42 fictional conversations, 6 domains, English and Chinese
provenance.selection: all cases; no answer-based or post-result filtering
provenance.authorship: New hand-authored fictional conversations; not generated from long_data.py templates. Identical intake questions deliberately check project isolation.
provenance.reuse_policy: After first scoring this is regression data. Do not tune on its outcomes and call the rerun heldout.
limits: Small synthetic stress set authored by the same assistant team, not a population sample or independent human annotation.
Short conversations and known evidence labels do not establish large-archive or real-user generalization.
Source-evidence retrieval only; no generated-answer quality is inferred.

provenance.indexing: every supplied paragraph in its own chapter/session; every original sentence is one canonical user turn; one project per problem; no query or QA labels indexed
provenance.date_convention: fixed synthetic date for neutral ordering; not article publication dates
limits: Externally authored encyclopedia multi-hop QA, not user conversation memory.
Scoped distractor setting; all supplied contexts indexed, not full Wikipedia retrieval.
All cases are answerable; this cohort does not measure abstention.
Strict complete-sentence evidence metric may be unattainable when a sentence crosses a canonical page boundary; report preflight failures without dropping cases.
After first evaluation these IDs become regression data.

methodology: All raw/summary/Markdown bytes match completed checkpoints. Full reports match summaries, and the registered cohorts, axes, repetitions and sources are checked. Historical checkpoints remain unchanged. Host-specific latency samples stay per cohort and are not pooled across recovery environments.
